description: PRODUCTION-GRADE hardcoded query templates - ALL SQL COPIED from tier2_views.py
important_notes: All SQL patterns are copied directly from tier2_views.py
Table names verified against actual database schema
Date columns verified: RoMaster.Date, CampaignRpt.RDate, SFSMaster.ServiceDate, PDIMaster.Date, FFSMaster.Date
Warranty data: RoMaster WHERE JobCatagories LIKE '%Warranty%' (note misspelling)
Dealership JOINs always use: LEFT JOIN DealerRegister d ON r.DealerId = d.ID WHERE d.DealerName IS NOT NULL

query_patterns: Total repair orders across all time
templates.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(*) as TotalRepairOrders FROM RoMaster
templates.description: Total count of all repair orders (no date filter)

templates.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(*) as TotalRepairOrders FROM RoMaster WHERE YEAR(Date) = '{year}'
templates.description: Count repair orders for a specific year

templates.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(*) as TotalRepairOrders FROM RoMaster WHERE FORMAT(Date, 'yyyy-MM') = '{year}-{month_num}'
templates.description: Count repair orders for specific month and year
templates.test_query: How many repair orders in December 2025?

query_patterns: Which dealership generated the most repair orders?
Which dealership generated the most repair orders of all time?
Top dealership by repair orders historically
templates.sql_template: SELECT d.DealerName, d.DealerCode, COUNT(*) as TotalOrders, SUM(r.TAmount) as TotalRevenue, COUNT(DISTINCT r.VINNO) as UniqueVehicles, MIN(r.Date) as FirstOrder, MAX(r.Date) as LastOrder FROM RoMaster r LEFT JOIN DealerRegister d ON r.DealerId = d.ID WHERE d.DealerName IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DealerName, d.DealerCode ORDER BY TotalOrders DESC LIMIT 10
templates.description: Top 10 dealerships by repair order count (all time)
templates.test_query: Which dealership generated the most repair orders of all time?

query_patterns: Which dealership generated the most repair orders in {year}?
Top dealerships by repair orders in {year}
templates.sql_template: SELECT d.DealerName, d.DealerCode, COUNT(*) as TotalOrders, SUM(r.TAmount) as TotalRevenue, COUNT(DISTINCT r.VINNO) as UniqueVehicles, MIN(r.Date) as FirstOrder, MAX(r.Date) as LastOrder FROM RoMaster r LEFT JOIN DealerRegister d ON r.DealerId = d.ID WHERE d.DealerName IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(r.Date) = '{year}' GROUP BY d.DealerName, d.DealerCode ORDER BY TotalOrders DESC LIMIT 10
templates.description: Top 10 dealerships by repair orders for specific year
templates.test_query: Which dealership generated the most repair orders in 2025?

query_patterns: Which dealership submitted most PDI reports?
Which dealership submitted the most PDI reports historically?
Which dealership had most PDI reports?
templates.sql_template: SELECT d.DealerName, d.DealerCode, COUNT(*) as TotalPDI, SUM(CASE WHEN p.Status LIKE '%objection%' OR p.Status LIKE '%Rejected%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as PDIsWithObjections, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.Status LIKE '%objection%' OR p.Status LIKE '%Rejected%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as ObjectionRate FROM PDIMaster p LEFT JOIN DealerRegister d ON p.DealerID = d.ID WHERE d.DealerName IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DealerName, d.DealerCode ORDER BY TotalPDI DESC LIMIT 10
templates.description: Top 10 dealerships by PDI report count (all time)
templates.test_query: Which dealership submitted the most PDI reports historically?

query_patterns: Which dealership had most PDI reports in {year}?
Which dealership submitted most PDI reports in {year}?
templates.sql_template: SELECT d.DealerName, d.DealerCode, COUNT(*) as TotalPDI, SUM(CASE WHEN p.Status LIKE '%objection%' OR p.Status LIKE '%Rejected%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as PDIsWithObjections, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.Status LIKE '%objection%' OR p.Status LIKE '%Rejected%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as ObjectionRate FROM PDIMaster p LEFT JOIN DealerRegister d ON p.DealerID = d.ID WHERE d.DealerName IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(p.Date) = '{year}' GROUP BY d.DealerName, d.DealerCode ORDER BY TotalPDI DESC LIMIT 10

templates.test_query: Which dealership had most PDI reports in 2025?

query_patterns: What percentage of PDIs had objections?
Percentage of PDI reports with objections
templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Status LIKE '%objection%' OR Status LIKE '%Rejected%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as ObjectionPercentage, COUNT(*) as TotalPDI, SUM(CASE WHEN Status LIKE '%objection%' OR Status LIKE '%Rejected%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as PDIsWithObjections FROM PDIMaster
templates.description: Percentage of PDI reports that had objections or were rejected
templates.test_query: What percentage of PDIs had objections?
